chunks: He passed away on the night of Monday, the 22nd of Muharram al-Haram, in the year 460 AH, at the age of seventy-five years.

key_terms.الْحَرَامِ: the sacred/inviolable — standing epithet of the month of Muharram
key_terms.تُوُفِّيَ: passed away, died — passive verb (lit. 'was taken in full'), the standard Arabic expression for death
key_terms.مُحَرَّمِ: Muharram — the first month of the Islamic lunar calendar, one of the four inviolable (ḥaram) months

ai.seo_question: When did Shaykh al-Tā'ifa al-Ṭūsī, the author of Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām, pass away and at what age?
ai.summary: This editorial biographical note records the death of Shaykh al-Tā'ifa Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī, the author of Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām, who passed away on the night of Monday, 22 Muharram al-Ḥarām 460 AH, at the age of seventy-five. It is a later scribal addition preserved in the manuscript tradition to memorialise one of the most eminent jurists and hadith scholars of Shia Islam.
